_README: Copy this to config.json in YOUR school's classroom repo and fill in real values. One config.json per school repo. The gen-forms Action regenerates the request forms from it on every push. 'student_repo_pattern' controls the student repo name — edit it freely, but use the {course}/{semester}/{assignment}/{username} placeholders. ALWAYS use {course} (never a literal course name like 'cs120'), so copying a course block to a new course can't collide repos. If omitted, it defaults to {course}-{semester}-{assignment}-{username}.
_README_quiz: A quiz/exam takes "requires_code": true (see Q1). The student must then type a matching access code on the request form or NO repo is created. Put that code inside the Canvas quiz, so only a student who actually started the quiz has it — a time window alone does NOT protect an exam: while it is open anyone can provision the repo and read the questions early (see Q2 for the time-gate form, which is still available and can be combined). ⛔ The code itself is NEVER written here — this repo is PUBLIC. It lives in the PRIVATE <org>/classroom-admin repo, in quiz-codes.json, as {"<course>": {"<assignment>": "<code>"}}. Set both halves with: ops/config.sh <org> add-quiz <course> <id> <template> '<code>'.
